title: 'Ghost' caught on camera running away from woman at haunted farmhouse
excerpt: Ghost hunter Lottie Pschenyckyj visited a 270-year-old Cheshire farmhouse after hearing stories of hauntings on Facebook and YouTube.
content:
Ghost hunter Lottie Pschenyckyj visited a 270-year-old Cheshire farmhouse after hearing stories of hauntings on Facebook and YouTube.

09:00 ET, Sat, Oct 31, 2026 Updated: 09:29 ET, Sat, Oct 31, 2026

Ghost hunter Lottie Pschenyckyj says she captured a ghost on camera (Image: undefined)

A woman claims to have captured footage of a "ghost running away" from her at a reportedly "haunted" farmhouse.

Ghost hunter Lottie Pschenyckyj, 32, visited the 270-year-old Cheshire property after coming across accounts of paranormal activity on Facebook and YouTube. She set up her equipment - a sound recorder, motion detectors and video cameras - in November 2025 alongside her friend George, 41.

During the recording session, the pair heard a loud bang, but it wasn't until Lottie reviewed the footage a month later that she noticed what appeared to be a fast-moving dark shadow.

Lottie, a customer service worker from near Chester, said: "A lot of people talk about that place being haunted, but I've actually captured it, which is very exciting."

Lottie has traveled to several haunted locations around the U.K. (Image: undefined)

"I went there to find ghosts and have a video of one, so that's a job well done."

"It's bizarre. There's nothing in the history to explain it, but everyone says the land has a very unpleasant feeling, and the ghosts there want you to feel scared."

"It was a very, very scary place, but I guess that's why I was there, so I actually feel very lucky and blessed that I've had this experience."

Lottie's fascination with the paranormal began at age 15, after she grew up in a house she believed to be haunted, where objects appeared to move independently and her dogs seemed to interact with unseen presences.

She now visits allegedly haunted locations twice weekly, documenting her experiences for her YouTube channel, ExploreALot Paranormal.

DON'T MISS...

She earns about $1,100 a month traveling the U.K.'s several haunted sites (Image: undefined)

She earns approximately £1,000 monthly ($1,120), which she invests in traveling to various locations and paying up to £400 ($450) to hire them for the evening.

Following each visit, Lottie wafts burning sage over herself and her ghost-hunting equipment to cleanse it.

She utilizes a spirit box - a radio device that rapidly scans through multiple channels, supposedly allowing spirits to communicate with her.

She also employs a REM pod, which emits an alert when it detects nearby movement.

Speaking to Sell Us Your Story, she revealed she's heard her name called through the spirit box on five separate occasions, most recently just two months ago.

She explained: "It's the scariest thing ever when you hear your own name come out of it."

Lottie emphasized she always brings a companion on her paranormal investigations for safety reasons.

She's experienced such intense fear that she's fled from a "haunted" building in the past.

She recalled: "I'm getting braver, but it is very very scary."

"I was in this building and asked if anyone was there to make a noise. There were these massive bangs. I was like 'nope, no thank you,' I just ran."

Paranormal investigators must conduct thorough research to identify nearby "haunted" sites, enabling them to anticipate expected sounds, Lottie explained.

They must develop their auditory and visual perception to detect phenomena that cannot be attributed to conventional explanations, she noted.

Lottie claims she's visited nearly every "haunted" site across England.
